text: How much Russian refining is disabled? Ukraine's General Staff: 42.74% (July 2026). IEA: 'more than 20%' at peak. Reuters: national oil processing fell only 3–6%. Three measures, same strikes.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed and not adjudicated. Reuters and IEA as-of dates are not specified in the tracker data, so a human should confirm the dates before publishing.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak
Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3–6%
factChecks.source: russian-fuel-crisis unresolved disputes; as-of date not given

text: How many are missing after the Nepal floods? Nepal Police counted 4,718 on 30 Sep, and 5,132 as of 14 Oct. Other compilations range from 5,285 to 6,145, with ~1,000 names added by bookkeeping. No newer official count has been published.

judge.comment: Figures and dates come from the tracker KPIs and disputes; the 'no newer count' claim rests on the Nov 25 digest search, which is not exhaustive.

factChecks.claim: Nepal Police: 4,718 missing on 30 Sep
5,132 missing as of 14 Oct
Other compilations 5,285 to 6,145 missing
No newer official count
